comment: Tandem halogenation of aminoacyl-S-carrier substrates (l-Aba-S-CytC2 and l-Val-S-CytC2) in γ,γ-dichloroaminobutyrate biosynthesis. L-Val-S-CytC2 yields a higher amount of dichlorinated product. CytC3 and SyrB2 are similar in structure. Neither GenPept nor MiBig entry
